transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this week's course-materials meeting. As we work to finalize the reserve plan for the upcoming undergraduate course, I want to make sure we have all the information we need. I understand the draft plan currently includes 40 simultaneous digital users, 10 print copies, and scanned PDF files. Before I make a final decision, I'd like to hear from each of you. Could the instructor share any details about the course enrollment or how students will use these materials? Copyright librarian, do you have any concerns about the scanned PDFs or licensing? Accessibility coordinator, are there any accessibility issues we need to address? And bookstore manager, is there anything we should know about the reading packet availability? I want to make sure the required reading packet is available to students before the course begins, so let's work through any outstanding issues today.
